feeds.title: The Forgotten Initiative
feeds.description: The Forgotten Initiative (TFI) resources, supports and networks Advocates across the nation, helping them grow sustainable foster care ministries in their communities. The foster care community exists because the brokenness in our world affects family relationships. Mission is to bring joy and purpose to the foster care community.

feeds.title: Christian Alliance for Orphans » Foster Care
feeds.description: The Christian Alliance for Orphans works to inspire, equip and connect Christians to care for the orphan. The Christian Alliance for Orphans exists to motivate and unify the body of Christ to live out God's mandate to care for the orphan with the vision to have every orphan experience God's unfailing love and know Jesus as Savior.

feeds.title: CHLSS Blog » Foster Care Adoption
feeds.description: Children's Home Society & Lutheran Social Service of MN provide adoption, post adoption & child welfare services to help families & children thrive. Children's Home helps unite children with permanent, loving families through adoption and supports all members of the adoption circle throughout their lifelong journey

feeds.title: Foster the Family Blog
feeds.description: One mom's light-hearted musings and heavier broodings on foster care, gospel-centered parenting, and mission-focused family. The goal of this blog is to help moms foster their families to love Jesus and be mission focused.

feeds.title: Lorimer Fostering
feeds.description: Lorimer has been at the heart of fostering for a number of years, helping and supporting hundreds of young people. As more and more children in the UK are in desperate need of a loving home, we're always looking for more potential foster carers who share our passion for transforming young lives. Find out the latest new, event and information about Lorimer Fostering.

feeds.title: Upbring Blog
feeds.description: Upbring delivers innovative programs and services that make measurable progress toward five key markers of every child's success: safety, health, education, life skills and vocation.Our life-changing programs include foster care, adoption, education, residential treatment and community services.

feeds.title: FosterMore
feeds.description: FosterMore is an unparalleled coalition of media and entertainment companies, foundations, non-profits, businesses and philanthropic organizations working to create greater understanding, empathy, and action to improve the future of youth in foster care.

feeds.title: Foster Care Blog
feeds.description: As a KidsPeace foster parent, you can make all the difference in the life of a child. There are more than 400,000 children and teens in the Foster Care system, and every single one deserves a chance at happiness, belonging, safety and love.

feeds.title: Sunrise Children's Services Blog
feeds.description: Sunrise Children's Services provides care and hope for hurting families and children through Christ-centered ministries. Our goal is to: keep families together when possible; find children temporary or permanent families when it is not safe for them to stay with their families; and to bring healing and hope that prevents the cycle of abuse from continuing into future generations.

feeds.title: Arizona Friends of Foster Children Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Arizona Friends of Foster Children Foundation's blog which is an everyday resource for anything regarding the foster care system. We promote the self-esteem and enrich the lives of Arizona's children in foster care by funding athletic, educational and social activities.

feeds.title: Mamamem Christian Adoption & Foster Care Blog
feeds.description: Mary launched her blog to educate and advocate for fostering, and to vent about her experiences adopting three foster care children and caring for many others. Much of the blog is a how-to resource for prospective parents with tips on making the decision and advice on fostering or adopting.

feeds.title: Five Rivers
feeds.description: Five Rivers is a leading independent, Social Enterprise working with 'Looked-after Children' in need of specialist care services in the UK and Ireland. Mission to provide quality care for vulnerable children, keeping children safe reinforcing traditional values and boundaries. Turning lives around for the better.

feeds.title: Foster Care Institute​ Dr. John DeGarmo Blog
feeds.description: Dr. John DeGarmo is a entertaining and informative speaker and trainer for not only the foster care system, but also is a consultant for legal agencies, and foster care agencies across the nation.

feeds.title: The Secret Foster Carer's Blog
feeds.description: We support our foster carers giving them the tools needed to help young people achieve their full potential and go on to live happy and healthy adult lives.

feeds.title: The Glorious Mundane
feeds.description: An extension of The Glorious Mundane blog by Suzanne Hines. Through this blog, I aim to open up and share my life: goals, dreams, aspirations, and daily life-- both the messes and successes! Sometimes life can feel mundane- but I believe that God can make even the most mundane life bring him glory!

feeds.title: LiKa Family Fostering Blog
feeds.description: An innovative foster agency on an inspiring journey to improve the standards of training and support of foster carers in the U.K. we are the difference. Our Foster Care Blog is full of case studies and expert advice designed to keep you inspired and interested about all things fostering. Find out more today

feeds.title: Foster ACTION Ohio
feeds.description: As a former foster child, my passion is advocating for and with foster care youth, publicizing the challenges that they face and addressing their developmental and emotional needs through workshops.

feeds.title: Kitsap Foster Care Association
feeds.description: Kitsap Foster Care Association (KFCA) is a non-profit organization formed in 1991. We are dedicated to the foster care system, foster parents and foster children living in Kitsap County, Washington. Our membership is strictly voluntary and is made up of foster parents licensed by the State of Washington and other local, private, agencies.

feeds.title: Foster Care Alumni of America Blog
feeds.description: Foster Care Alumni of America (FCAA) connects the alumni community and transforms policy & practice, ensuring opportunity for people in & from foster care. This vision for Foster Care Alumni of America was developed by alumni of foster care—adults who once were in foster care.

feeds.title: The New Day Charities
feeds.description: New Day Foster Home is committed to providing life-changing surgeries and a loving home to orphans with special needs from around . For prospective adoptive parents, this information is not intended to be a substitute for a complete and up-to-date referral packet from your adoption agency.

feeds.title: Swiis Foster Care News
feeds.description: Get the latest news and blog posts from Swiis Foster Care's local offices, placement support sessions, and more. This is how we make a difference to children's lives through positive outcomes.

feeds.title: Children's Rights News
feeds.description: Children's Rights is a national watchdog organization advocating on behalf of abused and neglected children in the U.S. Children's Rights is proving that failing child welfare systems not only can be fixed, but can be made to run well.

feeds.title: A Musing Maralee
feeds.description: A Musing Maralee is where you can find my thoughts on motherhood, adoption, foster care, faith, & family.

feeds.title: The Future Is Family
feeds.description: Real stories of real people making a difference in the world by being agents of change in the foster, adoptive and kinship communities.

feeds.title: Foster Arizona Blog
feeds.description: Foster Arizona is a non-profit public charity focused on educating the general public on the need for more foster and adoptive families. Their mission is to, through awareness, see an increase in children in Arizona's foster care system cared for in an in-home setting with parental figures approved to foster and/or adopt.

feeds.title: Utah Foster Care Blog
feeds.description: Utah Foster Care finds, educates, and supports families to care for children placed in foster care. We are a non-profit organization created and authorized by the Utah legislature. There are some 2,700 Utah children in foster care. Utah Foster Care finds and trains families to provide secure, loving homes for children in foster care.

feeds.title: JCCA Blog
feeds.description: JCCA, a not-for-profit, comprehensive, multicultural agency, has been serving children and families since 1822. JCCA's programs in New York City, Westchester County and Long Island include: group and family day care, mental health and preventive serices, education programs, a residential diagnostic center, foster homes, group homes and residential services for children and adolescents.

feeds.title: Monroe Harding | Nashville Foster Care Services
feeds.description: Monroe Harding changes the lives of young people! We have programs that provide a safe stable home for children and youth in foster care. We provide security, support and give young people a chance for success.

feeds.title: Legally Kidnapped
feeds.description: Exposing The Child Protective Industry For What It Really Is.

feeds.title: Hope Connections Blog
feeds.description: Stacy Manning created Hope Connections to offer education, tools, and coaching to deal with traumatized children, especially those families with adopted or foster children. Stacy Manning and Hope Connections offer hope to families, caregivers, and teachers in the form of multiple services which incorporate the use of hands-on tools.

feeds.title: Capturing Jewels
feeds.description: I'm Julia-- married to farmer Dan. I love Jesus and love loving on people! We are on a ttc journey; the struggle is real but we are full of hope, giving the pen to God knowing He scripts our story. January 2015 God called us to minister to kids in foster care & we are very passionate about loving these kids. Sharing our journey to raise awareness and glorifying God. Truly, no matter how rough the journey God can redeem it into a beautiful jewel.

feeds.title: Children First Foster Family Agency Shasta County Foster Parenting Blog
feeds.description: Children First Foster Family Agency is a private, nonprofit organization situated in rural Northern California. Articles with tips and tricks on foster parenting in Shasta County. We will keep you updated on the latest parenting news and help support your family.

feeds.title: Robyn, reunited: adoption, family, and learning how to fly
feeds.description: Robyn Cisar is a 28-year-old adoptee from the Natural State with a passion for writing. Robyn has stayed involved with the adoption community in central Arkansas by speaking at local foster and adoption support events hosted by non-profit organizations and churches. She also spoken to elementary and high school kids about foster care and adoption, as well as the need to introduce adoption education to schools. she feels to help bring an end to the orphan crisis by sharing her story and raising awareness.

feeds.title: CALIFORNIA STATE FOSTER PARENT ASSOCIATION | CSFPA
feeds.description: CSFPA provides support, advocacy, resources and education to all California Resource Families/Foster Parents Associations.

feeds.title: Phase Three of Life | Writings by Meghan M. Walbert
feeds.description: I'm a freelance journalist and essayist, a wife, mother to my spirited six-year-old biological son and a foster parent. Read more about our foster parent experience on my New York Times' Foster Parent Diary series and read more of my writing on my portfolio.

feeds.title: Lifesong for Orphans » Foster Care
feeds.description: Lifesong for Orphans exists to bring joy and purpose to orphans through adoption funding, in-country orphan care, church partnership, and foster care outreach.

feeds.title: Foster Youth Museum Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Foster Youth Museum, the largest collection of art, artifacts and video portraits about youth experiences in foster care. Conceived by current and former foster youth, the museum offers a unique opportunity to understand foster youth perspectives and how youth can heal and grow with supportive relationships, collaborative decision‐making, positive encounters, and respect.

feeds.title: Suddenly Mummy | Christian Fostering and Adoption Blog
feeds.description: A single woman's foray into fostering and adoption. This blog provides an honest account of a foster mum's experiences. She has also adopted one of her foster children and discusses that regularly, so this blog could be useful for anyone considering adoption after being a foster parent and the differences between the two.

feeds.title: Foster Care Closet of Nebraska
feeds.description: Foster CARE Closet shows God's love to His children through the giving of clothes and other items to children who are in the foster care system. Mission is to improve Nebraska's foster care system by serving Nebraska's foster youth with quality clothing and other basic care items with dignity, respect and cheerful giving.

feeds.title: The Foster Carer Hub
feeds.description: The Foster Carer Hub has information to support people in Australia who are already caring for a child or children in care as well as anyone considering becoming a carer.

feeds.title: The Central Missouri Foster Care & Adoption Association
feeds.description: A not for profit agency that educates, supports, and advocates for foster and adoptive children, youth and families in central Missouri.

feeds.title: What Now?
feeds.description: A candid account of my experience with foster/adopting a teenager in Los Angeles. My partner and I decided to become foster/adoptive parents in our late 30s. We had the great good fortune of being 'picked' by an amazing teenage boy who blows our minds on a daily basis. Adopting him turned out to be the best thing we've ever done, and by far the hardest.

feeds.title: JCFS Blog » Foster Care & Family Support
feeds.description: JCFS provides a range of comprehensive programs in Metropolitan Chicago designed to enable individuals and families to develop positively throughout their lives. It is the mission of Jewish Child & Family Services to provide help, healing and caring services infused with Jewish values to strengthen lives in the Jewish community and the community at large.

feeds.title: Foster Care to Success Blog
feeds.description: Foster Care to Success is over 30 years old - we're the largest provider of college funding and support services for foster youth in the nation!

feeds.title: Foster2Forever

feeds.title: Integrity Inc. Foster care

feeds.title: Fostering Blog

feeds.title: Grace Church

A central ministry to this church is supporting orphans and vulnerable children (OVC) through fostering and adoption.

feeds.title: Plummer Youth Promise
feeds.description: Plummer Youth Promise connect children in need of Massachusetts foster care. We provide services to help these children find safe and secure families.

feeds.title: One Big Happy Home Blog
feeds.description: One Big Happy Home exists to help create places of felt safety for children. We do this by equipping and supporting parents, agencies, churches.

feeds.title: National Foster Youth Institute
feeds.description: Welcome to the National Foster Youth Institute. Our coalition is dedicated to improving outcomes for foster youth and their families. Stay up to date with news & stories related to NFYI and foster youth through our NFYI blog and stories from actual foster youth.

feeds.title: Voices for Virginia's Children Blog
feeds.description: Voices for Virginia's Children is a statewide research and advocacy organization that champions public policies to improve the lives of children. Our mission is to improve the lives of children in Virginia by advancing effective public policies.

feeds.title: Olive Branch Fostering
feeds.description: Perpetual Fostering is an Independent Fostering Agency based in the Northwest and West Midlands. Read our insights about foster carer or foster parents. Here you will come know more about Perpetual Fostering and its services to become a foster carer.

feeds.title: Compass Fostering - Stepping Forward Together
feeds.description: Compass Fostering deliver professional, respectful and forward-thinking fostering services for children, carer families and local authorities.

feeds.title: Rainbow Fostering Blog
feeds.description: Rainbow is a long established independent fostering agency. We have a breadth of experience with a team of professionals dedicated to achieving successful outcomes for the children and young persons we place. Our commitment to our carers is second to none as we offer training with ongoing professional support on a 24 hour basis.

feeds.title: TAPESTRY | Adoption & Foster Care Ministry
feeds.description: Tapestry is the Adoption and Foster Care ministry of Irving Bible Church. The focus at Tapestry is primarily three fold: to connect, encourage and equip. Tapestry provides a loving, supportive and authentic community that encourages families along their adoption journey. It has been our experience that communities such as ours are a unique resource at each stage of the adoption or foster journey.

feeds.title: Simply Fostering Blog
feeds.description: Simply Fostering provides fostering information and choice of fostering agencies to potential and experienced foster carers.

feeds.title: Kids in a New Groove Providing free, private, at-home music mentorship to youth in foster care
feeds.description: Kids in a New Groove Provides Texas youth in foster care with a committed one-one mentoring relationship through weekly private music instruction, giving students the ability to build concrete strategies for life-long success.

feeds.title: The CALL No waiting children in Arkansas foster care

feeds.title: Diverse Care

feeds.title: Foster Care Technologies

We are creating a new standard in placement stability for foster children through the use of data-informed placement decision-making and a research-driven software matching system.

feeds.title: NH Foster & Adoptive Parent Association Blog
